Repository structure and import graph (acyclic): errors.py -> types.py -> template.py -> validation.py -> press_release.py -> search.py -> __init__.py -> Main.py -> tests/test_main.py. No module may import datetime, time, random, uuid, pathlib, os, threading, or any clock abstraction.

press_releases/errors.py:
- class DomainError(ValueError): domain-level error for invalid entity state or operation. No additional members.
- class InvalidTransitionError(DomainError): raised for invalid lifecycle transitions. No additional members.

press_releases/types.py:
- enum State(Enum): DRAFT, REVIEW, PUBLISHED. Represents lifecycle states of a press release.
- @dataclass(frozen=True) class Contact: fields name: str, email: str. Value object; uses only generated __init__.
- @dataclass(frozen=True) class VersionEntry: fields number: int, rendered_text: str. Value object; uses only generated __init__.

press_releases/template.py:
- @dataclass(frozen=True) class Template:
  - name: str
  - content: str
  - def render(self, fields: dict[str, str] | None = None) -> str: Deterministic literal substitution that leaves unknown placeholders intact. Implementation is exactly:
    values = {} if fields is None else fields
    result = self.content
    for key in sorted(values):
        result = result.replace("{{" + key + "}}", values[key])
    return result
  Forbidden: parsing via split/regex/open-ended scanning; only the exact sorted key replacement loop is used.

press_releases/validation.py:
- def validate_headline(headline: str) -> bool: Returns True if headline is non-blank (after stripping), else False. Never raises.
- def validate_body(body: str) -> bool: Returns True if body is non-blank (after stripping), else False. Never raises.
- def validate_contact(contact: Contact) -> bool: Returns True if contact.name is non-blank (after stripping) and contact.email contains exactly one '@' with non-empty local part and domain part; otherwise False. Never raises.

press_releases/press_release.py:
- class PressRelease:
  - Constructor: def __init__(self, id: str, headline: str, body: str, contact: Contact, template: Template, custom_fields: dict[str, str] | None = None) -> None
    Behavior: ordinary mutable class (no @dataclass). Assigns internal attributes (_id, _headline, _body, _contact, _template, _custom_fields dict copy if provided else empty dict, _state starts State.DRAFT, _tags_list empty list, _tags_set empty set, _versions empty list). The constructor does not validate and never throws for invalid values so tests can construct invalid candidates.
  - Properties (read-only): id: str, headline: str, body: str, contact: Contact, state: State. Expose underlying fields without side effects.
  - def validate(self) -> bool: Orchestrates validations using validate_headline, validate_body, validate_contact; returns False on any invalid part; never raises.
  - def submit_for_review(self) -> None: If validate() is False, raise DomainError. Otherwise, requires current state is State.DRAFT; if not, raise InvalidTransitionError. On success sets state to State.REVIEW.
  - def publish(self) -> None: Requires current state is State.REVIEW; otherwise raise InvalidTransitionError. On first successful publish, set state to State.PUBLISHED and append exactly VersionEntry(number=1, rendered_text=self.render_plain_text()). Further publish attempts from non-REVIEW states should raise InvalidTransitionError; no additional version entries are added beyond the first publish as per requirement.
  - def add_tag(self, tag: str) -> None: Trim tag via tag.strip(). If empty after trim, raise DomainError. If not already present (based on exact string match, case-sensitive), add to _tags_list and _tags_set preserving insertion order.
  - def tags(self) -> list[str]: Returns a defensive copy (new list) of tags in insertion order.
  - def render_plain_text(self) -> str: Build a fields dict combining custom_fields with canonical keys: 'headline' -> self._headline, 'body' -> self._body, 'contact' -> self._contact.name, 'contact_name' -> self._contact.name, 'contact_email' -> self._contact.email. Call self._template.render(fields) and return the result.
  - def version_history(self) -> list[VersionEntry]: Returns a defensive copy (new list) of the version entries.
  Errors: Uses DomainError for invalid content submission; InvalidTransitionError for invalid state transitions.

press_releases/search.py:
- def search_by_tag(releases: list[PressRelease], tag: str) -> list[PressRelease]: Returns a new list preserving the order of non-None input entries whose tags include an exact normalized tag match. Normalization is trim-only (tag.strip()). Matching is exact string equality (case-sensitive) against stored tags. Never mutates inputs.
- def search_text(releases: list[PressRelease], query: str) -> list[PressRelease]: Returns a new list preserving order of non-None releases whose headline or body contains the query case-insensitively (both sides lowered). Never mutates inputs.

press_releases/__init__.py:
- Re-exports only the canonical names from submodules: DomainError, InvalidTransitionError; State, Contact, VersionEntry; Template; validate_headline, validate_body, validate_contact; PressRelease; search_by_tag, search_text. MUST NOT export or mention run_demo.

Main.py:
- def run_demo() -> dict[str, object]: Using absolute imports from press_releases, constructs a Template, Contact, and PressRelease, validates, adds a tag (e.g., 'media'), transitions DRAFT -> REVIEW -> PUBLISHED, triggers rendering and versioning, then returns a dict with representative keys such as {'release': PressRelease, 'state': State.PUBLISHED, 'rendered': str, 'versions': list[VersionEntry] or 'version_count': int}. Under if __name__ == '__main__': prints at most one concise line (e.g., the final state or rendered headline) and exits.

tests/test_main.py:
- Must contain exactly three tests as specified:
  1) Demo test: from Main import run_demo (separate literal line). Assert returned value is dict and state is State.PUBLISHED.
  2) Rendering/validation/lifecycle/version test: Template('basic','{{headline}}|{{body}}|{{contact_email}}'), Contact('Alice','a@b.com'), PressRelease(..., headline='Hello', body='Body', ...). validate() True; submit_for_review(); publish(); version_history() length exactly 1; entry.number == 1; entry.rendered_text == 'Hello|Body|a@b.com'.
  3) Invalid/transition/tags/search test: Construct invalid candidate with blank headline and Contact('','invalid'); candidate.validate() is False; with pytest.raises(DomainError): candidate.submit_for_review(). Construct separate valid_draft with headline 'Hello' and body; without calling submit_for_review(), assert with pytest.raises(InvalidTransitionError): valid_draft.publish(). Then add 'media' then 'news' tags; tags() order preserved; search_by_tag([valid_draft], ' media ') returns [valid_draft]; search_text([valid_draft], 'hello') returns [valid_draft]. The third test MUST NOT call valid_draft.submit_for_review() before its expected failing publish.
